```{r} 
####Step 4####
library(tidyverse) 
library(psych)
library(readxl)
library(gt)
library(janitor)

####Step 5####
Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety <- read_excel("Attachment_Anxiety_Data.xlsx")

####Step 6####
Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety <- Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety%>%
  mutate(Gender = ifelse(Gender == 1, "male", "female"))%>%
  mutate(Ethnicity = case_when(
    Ethnicity == 1 ~ "white/Caucasian",
    Ethnicity == 2 ~ "Asian/Asian British",
    Ethnicity == 5 ~ "Other ethnic group",
    Ethnicity == 6 ~ "prefer not to say"
  )  
    
  )

Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety <- Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety %>%
  mutate(across(SA_1:SEst_10, as.integer))

####Step 7####
Answer_Key <- list(
  Social_Interaction_Anxiety_Scale = c("SA_1", "SA_2", "SA_3", "SA_4", "-SA_5", "SA_6", "SA_7", "SA_8", "-SA_9", "SA_10", "-SA_11", "SA_12", "SA_13", "SA_14", "SA_15", "SA_16", "SA_17", "SA_18", "SA_19", "SA_20"),
  Experiences_in_Close_Relationships_Anxiety_Subscale = c("AA_1","AA_2", "AA_3", "AA_4", "AA_5", "AA_6", "AA_7", "AA_8", "AA_9"),
  Rosenberg_Self_Esteem_Scale = c("SEst_1", "-SEst_2", "SEst_3", "SEst_4", "-SEst_5", "-SEst_6", "SEst_7", "-SEst_8", "-SEst_9", "SEst_10")
)

####Step 8####
SA_Score <- scoreItems(
  keys = Answer_Key["Social_Interaction_Anxiety_Scale"],
  items = Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety,
  min = 0,
  max = 4)

AA_Score <- scoreItems(
  keys = Answer_Key["Experiences_in_Close_Relationships_Anxiety_Subscale"],
  items = Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety,
  min = 1,
  max = 7)

SEst_Score <- scoreItems(
  keys = Answer_Key["Rosenberg_Self_Esteem_Scale"],
  items = Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety,
  min = 1,
  max = 4)

SA_score.df <- as.data.frame(SA_Score$scores)
AA_score.df <- as.data.frame(AA_Score$scores)
SEst_score.df <- as.data.frame(SEst_Score$scores)

allscores.df <- cbind(SA_score.df, AA_score.df, SEst_score.df)

####Step 9####
Final_Data <- cbind(Dataframe_AttachmentAnxiety, allscores.df)

####Step 10####
Reduced_df <- Final_Data%>%
  select(c("URN", "Gender", "Ethnicity", "Social_Interaction_Anxiety_Scale", "Experiences_in_Close_Relationships_Anxiety_Subscale", "Rosenberg_Self_Esteem_Scale"))

####Step 11####
demographic.table <- Reduced_df |>
  tabyl(Gender, Ethnicity) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Participant Gender and Ethnicity"
  )

####Step 12####
sample_size <- nrow(allscores.df)
summary <- describe(allscores.df) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Scales")

alphas <- round(c(
  SA_Score$alpha,
  AA_Score$alpha,
  SEst_Score$alpha
), 2)

summary_selected <- summary |>
  select(Scales, mean, median, sd, min, max, range)

summary <- cbind(summary_selected, alphas)

summary_table <- summary |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Descriptive Statistics and Reliability",
    subtitle = "Summary of Scale Scores"
  )

####Step 13####
FemaleOnly_df <- Final_Data |>
  filter(Gender == "female")

####Step 14####
sample_sizeFemaleOnly <- nrow(FemaleOnly_df)

FemaleOnly_scores <- FemaleOnly_df |>
  select(
    Social_Interaction_Anxiety_Scale,
    Experiences_in_Close_Relationships_Anxiety_Subscale,
    Rosenberg_Self_Esteem_Scale
  )

summary_filteredGender <- describe(FemaleOnly_scores) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Scales")

#Calculating alphas again#

SA_ScoreFemale <- scoreItems(
  keys = Answer_Key["Social_Interaction_Anxiety_Scale"],
  items = FemaleOnly_df,
  min = 0,
  max = 4
)

AA_ScoreFemale <- scoreItems(
  keys = Answer_Key["Experiences_in_Close_Relationships_Anxiety_Subscale"],
  items = FemaleOnly_df,
  min = 1,
  max = 7
)

SEst_ScoreFemale <- scoreItems(
  keys = Answer_Key["Rosenberg_Self_Esteem_Scale"],
  items = FemaleOnly_df,
  min = 1,
  max = 4
)

alphasFemale <- round(c(
  SA_ScoreFemale$alpha,
  AA_ScoreFemale$alpha,
  SEst_ScoreFemale$alpha
), 2)

summary_Filtered_selected <- summary_filteredGender |>
  select(Scales, mean, median, sd, min, max, range)

summary_filteredGender <- cbind(summary_Filtered_selected, alphasFemale)

summary_tableFiltered <- summary_filteredGender |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Descriptive Statistics and Reliability For Females",
    subtitle = "Summary of Scale Scores for Females"
  )

```

## Intro

Here is my introduction. 

## Methods

Participants were asked to complete a set of questionnaires.

## Participants
The sample consisted of `r sample_size` participants.
Here are the participants' demographics: 
```{r}
demographic.table 
```

## Measures

Here is are the measures used: Social Interaction Anxiety Scale Questionnaire, Experiences in Close Relationships Anxiety Subscale Questionnaire, and the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale Questionnaire. The  Cronbach’s alphas for the scales are `r alphas[1]`, `r alphas[2]`, and `r alphas[3]`, respectively. 

## Data Analysis Strategies 

Items items 5, 9, and 11 were reverse coded for the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale responses, and  items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 for Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale. This was done by adding a minus sign within the column name bracket (e.g., c(..."-SA_5"))

## Results

Here is the demographics summary table: `r summary_table`

The mean score for Social Interaction Anxiety was `r summary$mean[1]`, the mean score for Experiences in Close Relationships Anxiety was `r summary$mean[2]`, and the mean score for Rosenberg Self-Esteem was `r summary$mean[3]`.

For the female participants specifically, the demographics summary appears as follows:`r summary_tableFiltered`

The mean score for the female participants for the Social Interaction Anxiety questionnaire was `r summary_Filtered_selected$mean[1]`, the mean score for Experiences in Close Relationships Anxiety for females was `r summary_Filtered_selected$mean[2]`, and the mean score for Rosenberg Self-Esteem for females was `r summary_Filtered_selected$mean[3]`.
